content: The text provided is a list of references from various studies and articles related to the effects of hormonal contraceptives, particularly depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA) and other progestogen-only contraceptives, on bone mineral density, bleeding patterns, endometriosis-associated pain, and other health outcomes. It also includes studies on the impact of these contraceptives during lactation, postpartum periods, and their effects on adolescents, obese women, and postmenopausal women. The references are formatted in a standard citation style, listing authors, study titles, journal names, publication years, volumes, and page numbers.
